title: Design Systems
description: Multi-agent pipeline that turns a HTML/CSS theme into a versioned npm package with bundled MCP server.

session.roundDescription: Each Start round aborts any prior agent activity and spins up a fresh autonomous master that runs the pipeline (extract → components → pages → MCP → docs → storybook → publish) and exits. No human-in-loop questions.
